title: AI Fairness for People with Disabilities: Point of View
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement and does not discuss faith or religion. Its focus is on AI fairness for people with disabilities.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. The key findings are entirely focused on the unique challenges of ensuring AI fairness for people with disabilities, contrasting it with other protected characteristics like race, gender, and age.
references: Americans With Disabilities Act of 1990, Pub. L. No. 101-336, 104 Stat. 328 (1990).
